generate.title: Generate your app
generate.intro: Choose the safest path for your current situation. Djungo can reopen the last app, connect an existing Apps Script backend, or build a new app from Google Sheets exports.
generate.create_description: Follow these steps to turn your spreadsheet into an application.
generate.id_header: Make sure the first column is named ID.
generate.id_fill_start: If IDs are missing, enter 1 and 2 in the first two data rows.
generate.id_fill_handle: Select both cells and double-click the fill handle to extend the numeric series.
generate.id_unique: Check that every record has a unique positive integer ID. Keep existing valid IDs unchanged.
generate.sheet_instructions: Copy the URL from your Google Sheets browser address bar and paste it below. The spreadsheet must be accessible for import. Do not make confidential data public.
generate.other_ways_help: Resume your previous application or import exported spreadsheet files.
generate.export_title: 1B. Build a new app from Google Sheets exports
generate.persistent_backend: Google Sheets persistent backend (optional). Enter both identifiers to connect this app to the shared GAS.
generate.parser_description: The parser reads database structure, fields, formulas, enums and visual colors.
generate.deployment_description: After publishing the generated backend, enter the data needed to open the final database page.
generate.continue_help: Once the final files are ready and deployment is configured, use the final delivery page.
generate.export_intro: Use this option when you are starting from source files. Required inputs are:
generate.hosted_suffix: Frontend files are already managed by builder.sgbh.org.
generate.package_index: home page del database e CRUD finale
review.title: Customize
review.intro: On this page you can review the structure detected by Djungo before generating your final CRUD interface. Check fields, displayed names and colors for special values.
review.summary_help: Review the detected spreadsheet structure before generating the final app.
review.fields_help: Here you can review field labels and decide whether fields appear in the form or the final viewer. Parser-detected types cannot be changed at this stage.
review.colors_help: For fields with predefined values, you can adjust the colors displayed in the final viewer.
review.save_help: Review fields, labels and colors, then save your configuration. For manual exports, generate the application files.
review.warning_id_help: The generated CRUD app needs a unique record identifier to load, update and delete existing rows safely.
review.warning_id_after: column to the spreadsheet and import it again.
review.no_dropdown_description: This spreadsheet does not currently contain dropdown fields or selectable colored values.
review.no_dropdown_before: If you want to use colored selectable values, go back to Google Sheets and configure a column using
review.no_dropdown_after: . Then create dropdown values and assign colors to them.
review.reimport_instructions: After changing the spreadsheet structure, import the spreadsheet again. For manual imports, export the updated source files first.
review.hex_invalid: Enter a valid HEX color, for example #336699.
review.invalid_configuration: Invalid parsed configuration: expected an object.
review.no_builder_state: No builder state found in localStorage
review.builder_state_loaded: Builder state loaded automatically from parser result
review.missing_parser_session: Missing parser session_id. Return to generate.html and run parser again.
review.return_preview: After saving, you will return to the preview.
review.return_app: After saving, your application will reopen.
review.return_manual: After generating the files, you will continue to the application or delivery page.
